card.title: PlayStation 4 APU & RAM Health Impedance Checks To Ground

claims.statement: Verify APU health by measuring the impedance of capacitors on the +1.0 Vgpu and +0.93 Vcpu rails to ground.
claims.evidence: Capacitor measurements on the +1.0 Vgpu rail show 1 to 2.5 ohm or 1.3 ohm or 16 ohm, and the +0.93 Vcpu / +1.1 Vcpu rail shows 1.9 ohm.
claims.quote: Measure the impedance of the capacitors to check health of the APU +1,0 Vgpu One side = GND Other side = 1 – 2.5 ohm +1,0 Vgpu +0,93 Vcpu 1,3 ohm

claims.statement: Verify RAM health by measuring the impedance of capacitors on the RAM rails to ground.
claims.evidence: Measurements on the RAM capacitors show one side connected to ground and the other side showing 59 ohm or 120 ohm.
claims.quote: Measure the impedance of the RAM to check health of the RAM One side = GND 120 ohm Other side = 59 ohm

card.caveats: Low resistance values on CPU/GPU rails are normal due to core design; verify against known good boards before condemning the APU.
